note.fr: <ph id='heidegger'>Heidegger</ph> reprend de <ph id='dilthey'>Dilthey</ph> la question de la vie historique et de sa compréhension, à laquelle il consacre un paragraphe d'<w id='being-and-time-heidegger'>Être et temps</w>. Il lui reproche de ne pas avoir posé la question de l'être de cette vie.
note.en: <ph id='heidegger'>Heidegger</ph> takes from <ph id='dilthey'>Dilthey</ph> the question of historical life and its understanding, to which he devotes a section of <w id='being-and-time-heidegger'>Being and Time</w>. He reproaches him for not having raised the question of the being of that life.
